summary: 매우 흔한 겨울철새이자 흔한 텃새로, 국내에서는 전국의 습지에서 볼 수 있다. 발가락에 판족이 있어 헤엄을 잘 치고 잠수에도 능하며, 위험하면 물속으로 들어가거나 수면을 박차고 달려 달아난다. 유라시아, 인도, 호주에 널리 분포한다.

art.subject: Eurasian Coot (Fulica atra), adult in winter, as seen on Korean wetlands from October to March: entire plumage sooty black, the head and neck blackest and the body slightly greyer; no white on the undertail. Short bill white to pale pinkish-ivory, continuing into a white frontal shield on the forehead; red eye; grey-green legs with long, lobed toes.
art.pose: swimming on open water, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter wetland with open water and reed-fringed shores; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view swimming: plump all-black body, white bill and frontal shield, red eye, no white on the tail

adult in flight seen from above: all-dark wings with a narrow white trailing edge to the secondaries, grey-green legs and lobed toes trailing beyond the short tail, head, body and tail in a straight line
juvenile (summer–autumn), side view swimming: grey-brown upperparts, whitish face, throat and foreneck, dull grey bill, little or no frontal shield
art.build: Medium-sized, plump waterbird, about 39cm, clearly smaller than a Mallard, with a rounded body sitting high on the water, a small rounded head and short neck; swims with a nodding head and dives with a small forward jump. Bill short, pointed and conical, shorter than the head, merging into the frontal shield. Legs strong, set well back, grey-green, the long toes bearing scalloped lobes instead of webs. Tail very short. Patters along the surface to take off; in flight a narrow white trailing edge to the secondaries.
avoid: Do not paint a red frontal shield, a yellow-tipped red bill or white undertail patches — that is Common Moorhen (Gallinula chloropus).
Do not paint webbed feet; the toes have separate scalloped lobes.
Do not paint a broad duck bill; the bill is short, pointed and whitish.
Do not paint a white flank line or a long tail.
